_comment: Answer key for the Marcy gate fixture. Read ONLY by the Scorer, never by the engine. event_ids list the events that belong to each workflow; intent is plain-language for the intent-judge.

bundles.intent: Customer purchase-order intake: read an inbound PO email, open the attached PO, enter the order into the ERP, and reply confirming receipt and ship date.
Send ship-confirmation emails for orders shipped, with carrier and tracking number, to each affected customer.
Supplier price update: read the new supplier costs and update the pricing sheet, and if a SKU falls below the margin threshold, copy it into a review tab (a conditional branch within one workflow).

Reorder low-stock items: flag low-stock SKUs to a reorder list in the morning, then later place the reorders from that list and mark them ordered (trigger and execution separated in time, linked by the reorder-list artifact).
Send batch payment reminders to customers with overdue invoices.
Daily inventory reconciliation: compare counted vs system quantities and post adjustments.
Post a notice to the team chat channel whenever a large order is received.
Compile and send the weekly summary report from the week's order and revenue numbers.

anti_bundles.intent: Custom pricing / bespoke quotes: deciding a discretionary discount or a one-off quote based on relationship, volume, and margins — a judgment call that differs each time.
Handling an upset customer complaint: crafting a personalized apology and resolution that depends on context and relationship.
